title: planRetentionSweep lists media purge-eligible when tenantId is inherited from the prototype, not an own property
evidence: Checker probe on c947689. Input: {tenantId:'toc', media:[o], claims:[{_id:'c1',tenantId:'toc',text:'x',status:'verified',evidence:[{turnId:'t1',sessionId:'s1'}]}], turns:[{_id:'t1',tenantId:'toc',sessionId:'s1',speakerRef:'a',tStart:100,tEnd:110,text:'x'}], now:Date.parse('2026-10-10T12:00:00.000Z'), params:{minAgeAfterProcessedMs:604800000, clipPaddingSeconds:15}} where o = Object.assign(Object.create({tenantId:'toc'}), {_id:'m1',sourceRef:'s',kind:'recording',turnRefs:['t1'],retention:{purgeAfterVerified:false},processedAt:'2026-10-03T11:59:59.000Z'}). Result: purgeEligibleIds ['m1'] (reason 'all 1 citing claim(s) are verified'). The record has no own tenantId, so tenant ownership is unproven yet it is listed for destruction.
fix_direction: Read tenantId (and _id, kind, retention, turnRefs, processedAt) only via Object.hasOwn / own-property checks, or reject any record whose prototype is not Object.prototype or null. Measure with the verbatim reproduction above: expect KEEP 'malformed record: missing tenantId'.

title: planRetentionSweep treats non-ISO strings such as '1', '0', '12', '2020' as a valid old processedAt and lists the media purge-eligible
area: packages/ingest/src/retention-sweep.ts:176-178 (Date.parse is lenient; V8 parses '1' as year 2001)
evidence: Checker probe on c947689, same input as ISS-T046-001 but media = [{_id:'m1',tenantId:'toc',sourceRef:'s',kind:'recording',turnRefs:['t1'],retention:{purgeAfterVerified:false},processedAt:V}] with V in ['1','0','12','2020']. Each gives purgeEligibleIds ['m1']. The input contract documents processedAt as an ISO-8601 string; 'garbage', 'tomorrow' and '2026-09-26x' are correctly kept, so the guard is partial. A corrupted or truncated timestamp therefore reads as long-processed.
fix_direction: Validate processedAt against a strict ISO-8601 date-time pattern (with timezone) before Date.parse; keep anything else. Measure with the four verbatim values above: each must be KEEP 'malformed processedAt'.

title: retention-sweep tests do not cover the purgedAt guard: mutation 'ignore purgedAt' survives all 16 tests
evidence: Mutation M3 on c947689: replacing `if (retention.purgedAt !== undefined && retention.purgedAt !== null) {` with `if (false) {` in retention-sweep.ts leaves `node --test --import tsx src/retention-sweep.test.ts` at 16 pass / 0 fail. Real code keeps media with purgedAt set; no test pins it. Property test also never generates purgedAt.
fix_direction: Add a test: media with retention {purgeAfterVerified:true, purgedAt:'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'} otherwise eligible must be keep with reason 'already purged...'; add purgedAt to the property generator.
